title: Sonic CD (JP/EU) - Wacky Workbench Zone (Bad Future)
description:
A fairly frantic theme from Sonic CD that could fit some kind of a self-destructing factory/tower/castle or whatever facility that can self destruct, or just factories/towers/castles in general.

*extremely robotic voice* GRAB THE ONIONS
YOU SUGGESTED LETTUCE
GRAB THE ONIONS
JUUUUUUUICE

Update: Fixed the tunings of some samples, changed the string sample in #6, fixed the desync that was happening at 0:49, and added legato to the jazz guitar sample along with $F4 $02 to make it smoother.
